title: State of the Feed — Week of July 27–2, 2026
content_html:
During the week of July 27–August 2, the aggregator completed 8 runs and processed 8,376 articles, delivering 512 quality articles across six primary content categories. AI-tech dominated the feed volume with 94 articles, followed by general news at 200 articles and wellness content at 64 articles. Science, climate, and local coverage comprised the remaining distribution, with 56, 35, and 32 articles respectively. Six new feeds were integrated, including regional sources (Williams Lake Tribune, My Cariboo Now Archives), technical blogs (Bambu Lab, blog.bgcarlisle.com), and Wikipedia recent changes, expanding coverage in local and maker hardware domains.

Pipeline efficiency remained consistent at a mean noise-to-signal ratio of 1.85 across the week's runs, indicating stable filtering performance with a range of 1.21 to 2.5. One feed, LoRaMeshDevices, experienced errors during the monitoring period. Discovery scoring identified blog.bgcarlisle.com as the strongest new candidate (70.2), followed by Municipal News Archives: My Cariboo Now (64.2) and 10ideas.bearblog.dev (63.9), all three exceeding the threshold for recommended addition.
